changelog:
@Announcements Ping Hi i released a hotfix again, should be the last one now! I need a break from doing development now 💀 

Changelog:
```- Fixed an issue where large patches folders could cause the game to crash when booting into RWFC.
- Fixed an issue where single mushrooms would occur in bottom placements.
- Fixed an issue with Online Time Trial where randomizing the track would select a Retro track, causing a crash.
- Fixed an issue with Online Time Trial where not selecting your combo after track vote would crash the game.
- Fixed an issue where Wii U Electrodome and Wii U Sunshine Airport's names were swapped on non english languages.
- Lowered the retro track final lap brstms pitch to be more accurate with nintendo's pitch.
- Updated the following tracks to addresss bugs:
 - SW2 Faraway Oasis
 - GP Diamond City
 - Wii U Sunshine Airport
- Added the new track brstms to the new files only zip.
- Added SW2 Mario Bros Circuit to the list of tracks that will not have any lightning flash.
- Updated N64 Mario and Kamek's item roulette sounds, curtosey of Mining.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.```

Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
